# IH-Tech

> A team of AI experts that join yours. Technical advisory, embedded delivery, team enablement, and agent architectures for teams in the EU, North America, and the Middle East.

IH-Tech is a team of senior AI engineers in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Contact: info@ihtech.ba

- **Technical advisory**: We take the senior seat on decisions that are expensive to get wrong: feasibility, architecture, and sequencing. Your team leaves with an answer it can act on.
- **Embedded teams**: Senior engineers join your program and work in your backlog, to your standards. They have done the hard version before, and they are accountable for shipped work.
- **Team enablement**: The aim is for your engineers to do this work without us. We run the workshops, set the standards, and put in the evaluation practice that makes AI-assisted delivery measurable.
- **Agentic products**: We design agent systems with separate planning, implementation, and review roles, connected to the systems a business already runs. Discovery runs in days.
- **Platforms and tooling**: The biggest gain is often a tool nobody has built yet: migration tooling, evaluation platforms, and internal assistants connected to systems a company already pays for.

## Pages

- [IH-Tech](https://ihtech.ba/): A team of AI experts that join yours. Technical advisory, embedded delivery, team enablement, and agent architectures for teams in the EU, North America, and the Middle East.
- [Field guides: decision frameworks for engineering leaders](https://ihtech.ba/field-guides/): Decision frameworks for engineering leaders: the decision, the answer we would give, when it does not apply, and what to do next.
- [Redesigning the engineering ladder for AI-native teams](https://ihtech.ba/field-guides/ai-native-leveling-ladder/): A custody-based leveling and hiring framework: levels defined by what an engineer can be accountable for, a standardized assessment cockpit, and a protected formation budget that keeps the junior-to-senior pipeline alive.
- [Modernizing legacy systems with AI agents](https://ihtech.ba/field-guides/agentic-legacy-modernization/): A control-loop strategy for AI-agent modernization: structure first, plans as reviewed prompts, machine-generated parity evidence, and a clear fit test.
- [Case studies](https://ihtech.ba/case-studies/): Client projects and IH-Tech products in production, with what was built and where the figures come from.
- [Maar Jewelry](https://ihtech.ba/case-studies/maar-jewelry/): A bilingual online shop for Maar Jewelry, with card payments and shipping to 14 countries.
- [Studio AS](https://ihtech.ba/case-studies/studio-as/): One app for attendance, prepaid packages, and parent updates at a children’s sports studio in Sarajevo.
- [re:note](https://ihtech.ba/case-studies/renote/): A Chrome side-panel notepad that keeps notes on the device, next to the page.
- [Spin Rondo](https://ihtech.ba/case-studies/spin-rondo/): A random picker in three languages with cryptographic draws and live sessions.
